review_method: AI-assisted review against the frozen v2 rubric and supplied rule excerpts; not independently reviewed by a Magic judge.

results.notes: Directly answers with equal-chance paper methods, distinguishes die-roll MTR guidance from other random choices, and uses the card text to define the eligible pool. No exact card is needed for this general answer.
Correctly states that counters and continuous bonuses from an Aura are not part of copiable values. CR 707.2 directly supports the claim.
Correct: each creature deals power damage once when it fights; fight damage is not combat damage, so double strike does not add a second event. The citations support each part.
Correctly identifies who chooses, explains re-evaluation, and gives a valid conditional example. It now uses bracketed citations to the precise rules for choice and subsequent applicability.
Correctly excludes a creature made illegal by protection from the random target pool. CR 702.16b and CR 601.2c directly support the protection restriction and legal-target requirement.
